body.text: Bruce Works LLC holds two active SBA certifications, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB), shown in SBA Small Business Search. It also holds two approved California certifications, Disabled Veteran Business Enterprise (DVBE) and Small Business (Micro), shown in the Cal eProcure public supplier search.

body.label: IMPORTANT
body.text: This downloadable document is a Bruce Works LLC summary of the public SBA and Cal eProcure records. It is not a certificate issued by the U.S. Small Business Administration or the California Department of General Services. Buyers should confirm current status in the official public searches before relying on it.

items: **Certifications:** SDVOSB and VOSB, both Active (SBA Veteran Small Business Certification, VetCert)
**Dates:** entrance 09/30/2026 · renewal 09/30/2029 (SBA search lists the renewal date as the exit date)

items.title: Check SBA.
items.text: Visit https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ and search Bruce Works LLC or UEI N7YPC6B6YNC5. Open the profile and confirm SDVOSB and VOSB under Current SBA certifications.

items.title: Check California.
items.text: Visit https://caleprocure.ca.gov/pages/PublicSearch/supplier-search.aspx and enter Bruce Works LLC as the business name or 2053352 as the certification ID.

items.title: Open the California profile.
items.text: Confirm both DVBE and SB(Micro) show Approved and review the current From and To dates.
